title: CalibrationFactors
description: Actual collector output view, not a registered receipt or release verdict.

inputs.description: Original-input group order, with each actual width recorded.

output.description: Actual output factor, absent for input-only statistics.

plan.description: Request actually used by this collector.

CalibrationConsumer.description: Consumer whose original-source values are being calibrated.

oneOf.description: Raw original-input activations of a linear projection.

Gather with the explicitly declared hidden-space identity approximation.
Requires indexed output factors; does not materialize vocabulary one-hots.

CalibrationFactor.description: View of one actual normalized factor and its existing numerical digest domain.

content.description: Existing InputGram or OutputFisher content digest, not a raw Gram digest.

dimension.description: Gram input width or Fisher output-row count.

selected.description: Selected samples, including selected zero-weight samples.

total_weight.description: Sum of selected weights used to normalize the factor.

CalibrationOutput.description: Declared output factor encoding; no gradients are inferred from activations.

oneOf.description: Input Gram only, without a Fisher claim.
One dense output-gradient vector per sample.
One named output-row factor per sample, zeros in other rows.

CalibrationPartition.description: Input statistics partition, independent of scale groups and basis blocks.

oneOf.description: Full original-input covariance, including cross-group correlations.
Explicit block-diagonal approximation; final group may be ragged.

columns.description: Positive block width, not a weight-format admission constraint.

CalibrationPlan.description: Candidate request for one tensor's original-basis calibration factors.

damping.description: Absolute diagonal damping after output-factor scaling.

max_numeric_bytes.description:
Bound on numerical reducer/transaction/finalization workspace bytes.
Excludes caller buffers, metadata/allocator overhead and full process RSS.

output.description: Actual output encoding required for every batch.

sample_start.description: Canonical global ordinal of the first sample in this shard.

tensor.description: Exact original matrix interpretation, not fitted weights.

CalibrationSource.description:
Declared identities of the already finalized calibration source/cache.
The collector binds them; cache/source producers must independently verify them.

cache.description: Finalized activation/gradient cache manifest and content identity.

model.description: Original source content identity, not a fitted model/package identity.

tokens.description: Ordered token stream and tokenizer provenance identity.

FitInputDigest.description:
Exact original fitting input bits under a named candidate digest domain.
Not a stored blob, package, HF identity or calibration dataset identity.

QuantSourceTensor.description: Original tensor interpretation, never an adapter-supplied content hash.

precision.description: Original stored float precision, before widening or fitting.

shape.description: Positive row-major dimensions in the original source.

ScalePrecision.description: Precision used to store additive plane scales.
